label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Whatever is maximally TRUE_1 is maximally a being
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quarta via: nam quae sunt maxime vera, sunt maxime entia, ut dicitur II Metaphys.
interpretation: The maximum in truth is a maximum in being. Aquinas cites Aristotle, Metaphysics II.1, 993b30-31 ('as each thing stands to being, so it stands to truth'), which supports the step but is read here only through Aquinas' sentence. The reading takes 'per consequens maxime ens' as said of the same thing that is verissimum.
